steps.arg: message back by six. the pigeon is still on the cupboard, year nine have named it.

steps.why: One frame, not sixteen. The sixteen were meant to be the folded note landing — and measured on the frames the twelfth capture wrote, all sixteen are byte-identical: the landing does not move under the driven clock. That is a fault of its own, written into evidence/logs/06_unfolding.frames.json and into the handover, and it is not something this clip should paper over by holding on a still note for a quarter of a second before it opens.
